subject: Request: Starter Surge credits + SLA carveout for onramp pilot
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aperturesystems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — additional credits and temporary SLA adjustment

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We want to run a full 6-week onramp pilot that exercises real inference at scale (document ingestion + chat UI). Two items from procurement that will determine whether we can move forward this month:

1) Additional free credits: the engineering team expects ~1.2M tokens for the pilot. Can Redwood provide a one-time credit top-up beyond the standard trial (approx 0.9M tokens extra)?

2) SLA carveout: our security lead flagged that for the pilot we can’t commit to the production-level response-time SLA (certain peak windows may see higher latency). They asked if Redwood can accept a temporary deviation for the pilot window (6 weeks) and then revert to standard SLAs on conversion.

We understand exec approval may be needed. If you can share what you typically approve for early-stage pilots, that will help speed procurement.

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Product, Aperture Systems

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask — additional credits and temporary SLA adjustment

Aditya / Ben — forwarding request from Aperture. Quick summary: they want a 6-week onramp pilot, asking for a one-time extra ~0.9M token credit (on top of their trial allocation) and a temporary SLA carveout for the pilot period due to load variability. Procurement specifically called this out as an "SLA exception" requirement before signing an MPA.

Recommendation I discussed with solutions: provide 1.0M free-token credit, require active monitoring + a throttle cap during peak windows (so we limit worst-case cost exposure), and document the carveout in the MAP (pilot appendix) that explicitly reverts to standard SLA on conversion.

Can you draft the concession summary and estimate the cost exposure? If we need Marissa's sign-off for anything beyond 1.0M tokens or a rate/term change, flag it here. I attached the draft MAP and their SOC2 snapshot they shared.

We should move quickly — they want answers this week.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0147

Attachments: StarterSurge_MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask — additional credits and temporary SLA adjustment

Team — quick calc and suggested concession language for exec: 

Cost exposure if we provide 1.0M free tokens: ~USD 2,800 (based on their expected generation/embedding mix). If we sweeten to 1.2M tokens it's ~USD 3,350.

Suggested offer (balanced):
- One-time pilot credit: 1.0M tokens (applied to their account, expires 8 weeks from activation)
- Temporary SLA carveout: agree to pilot SLA appendix that allows latency variance during pre-defined peak windows; we will set a soft throttle at 95th percentile to prevent runaway cost.
- Conditions: technical onboarding call within 48 hours of activation; weekly syncs and shared observability access (console dashboards).

I recommend routing this for Marissa's approval if they want >1.0M tokens or any permanent term changes (discounts on committed pricing). For the pilot-specific MAP appendix, I've placed placeholder language and a DocuSign packet link in the MAP.

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/pack/rdw-RDW-2027-0452
HubSpot: HS-523487

If you want, I can pre-fill the concession box and escalate to Marissa with the recommended figures.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask — additional credits and temporary SLA adjustment

Evelyn / Aditya — I support the recommended concession. A couple of practical notes from PS side: 

- Make the credit conditional on completion of the onboarding checklist (ingestion test, latency baseline capture). That reduces risk and gives us telemetry to validate the pilot.
- If they hit 80% of the credit within 3 weeks, we trigger a review call and can discuss an incremental top-up conditional on conversion signal.

From an exec-escalation lens: approve up to 1.0M one-time token credit + pilot MAP appendix SLA carveout (explicitly timeboxed to the 6-week pilot). Anything greater should come to Marissa for sign-off.

I can own the onboarding checklist and the throttle configuration. Evelyn, if you get verbal buy-in we can send the MAP + DocuSign and loop Marissa for formal sign-off.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask — additional credits and temporary SLA adjustment — Exec approval

Thanks for the context and the numbers. I reviewed the exposure and the guardrails Aditya/Ben propose. I approve the following exception for RDW-2027-0452 (Aperture Systems):

- One-time pilot credit: 1.0M tokens (applied as a credit, expires 8 weeks after activation)
- Pilot SLA appendix: temporary, timeboxed deviation for the 6-week pilot with the throttle/95th-percentile guardrail as described; SLA reverts to standard terms on conversion.
- Conditionality: credits active only after completion of the onboarding checklist and a signed MAP appendix (DocuSign packet).

Evelyn — proceed to send the MAP and DocuSign link to Aperture with the concession terms. Make sure PS gets the onboarding window scheduled (Ben to lead). Please copy me in the DocuSign envelope when you send it.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
